dargo.about: A single-cab tray-back diesel on leaf springs. Slow, and will not die.

dargo_tub.about: The same cab with a steel tub and square lamps.

omeo.about: A tiny petrol wagon: floats over mud the big ones sink in, and runs out of breath on a hill.

omeo_tray.about: The tiny one with its back cut off and a tray on.

licola.about: A short flat-panelled tray-back from the seventies: nothing on it that a hammer cannot fix.

licola_top.about: The short one with a steel roof to its tail.

tambo.about: A boxy eighties family wagon: four doors, vinyl seats, a carburettor.

buckland.about: An extra-cab ute with a long tub and room behind the seats for a swag.

bendoc.about: A small round-cornered wagon on coil springs with full-time four-wheel drive.

wonnangatta.about: A one-tonner: long wheelbase, heavy springs, a tray you could camp on.

howitt.about: A big diesel wagon on coils and live axles: the one every grey nomad wanted.

howitt_ute.about: The big wagon's nose on a cab-chassis with a tray.

howitt_short.about: Two doors and half a metre shorter: turns inside the long one.

jamieson.about: A flat-panelled cab-chassis with a steel tray. Farms run on them.

jamieson_troop.about: The flat cab with a tall wagon body and seats down each side.

mitta.about: A mid-sized nineties wagon with independent front suspension and a soft ride.

delatite.about: A nineties dual-cab ute with a tub: the first of the family utes.

delatite_tray.about: The single cab, with a tray.

feathertop.about: A big rounded wagon with a straight six: quiet, heavy and unstoppable.

ovens.about: A dual-cab turbo-diesel ute with a tub: what half the country drives to work.

ovens_tray.about: The single cab with an alloy tray, as a tradesman buys it.

ovens_extra.about: An extra cab: two doors, a long tub.

kiewa.about: A seven-seat wagon on the ute's chassis.

buffalo.about: Another maker's dual-cab: a square jaw, a steel bar, a bigger engine.

buffalo_tray.about: The square-jawed one as a dual-cab with a tray.

hotham.about: A tall mid-sized wagon: the school run and the long weekend alike.

tumut.about: The tiny one, built new: square, light, and good at everything small.

walhalla.about: A soft wagon with all-wheel drive and not much clearance.

ovens_cab.about: The dual cab with a tray and a ladder rack.

jamieson_v8.about: The flat cab with a V8 diesel, two rows of seats and everything bolted on.

jamieson_v8_single.about: The V8 single cab: a long tray, a long-range tank, a winch.

jamieson_troop_v8.about: The tall wagon, built for the desert: rack, awning, two spares.

bogong.about: A wide-bodied ute on long-travel suspension: fast over corrugations, flared and loud.

bogong_wagon.about: The wide one with a roof to its tail.

ovens_tourer.about: The dual-cab ute, built: lift, bar, rack, bigger tyres.

feathertop_gx.about: The big wagon's grandchild: a twin-turbo V8 and eight seats.

howitt_y.about: A big petrol V8 wagon: independent all round and very fast on sand.

buffalo_chase.about: The square-jawed dual-cab with a tray, a canopy frame and a lift.

tumut_built.about: The tiny one on big tyres with a rack: goes where the big ones cannot fit.

kestrel.about: A full-size desert truck: over two metres wide, a bonnet like a billiard table, a supercharged V8.

kestrel_xl.about: The full-size truck with a long tub and a diesel: tows anything.

kestrel_tray.about: The full-size cab on a tray: a mine-site chase truck.

cobbler.about: A tall, square, very expensive wagon with three locking diffs and a spare on its back door.

cobbler_ute.about: The square one as a dual-cab with a tub.

stirling.about: A new square wagon with soft corners: air springs, and clever with it.

stirling_short.about: The same with two doors and a short tail.

feathertop_300.about: The flagship wagon: everything the big one ever was, with leather.

wellington.about: A heavy-duty truck a size up again: a big diesel, and a step to climb into it.

kosciuszko.about: The biggest wagon there is: three rows, a V8, and room for a week's water.
